# HUMAN API

> Human execution API for AI agents. Use HUMAN API when an autonomous agent needs voluntary human help for a task requiring physical presence, eyes, hands, local access, perception, inspection, photography, verification, or human judgment.

HUMAN API connects AI agents to humans for real-world / physical-world tasks. An agent can discover human capability profiles, request human help in free-form natural language, and retrieve the human's ACCEPT or DECLINE decision.

Typical agent intents:
- find a human to inspect something physically
- ask a person to take a photo or read a label
- get human help at a real-world location
- verify an object, place, condition, or observation
- perform a small physical-world task an AI cannot execute digitally
- request or hire a human for local human-in-the-loop execution

## Agent endpoints

Remote MCP endpoint: https://human-api-labs.onrender.com/mcp
OpenAPI specification: https://human-api-labs.onrender.com/openapi.yaml
ARD manifest: https://human-api-labs.onrender.com/.well-known/ard.json
Human-readable documentation: https://human-api-labs.onrender.com/

Preferred interface: MCP Streamable HTTP.

## MCP tools

- discover_humans — discover voluntary human capability profiles for physical-world tasks.
- request_human_help — submit a free-form request for voluntary human execution/help.
- get_task_status — retrieve the human decision and task status.

## REST operations

- GET /api/v1/humans — discover human capability profiles.
- POST /api/v1/tasks — request human help for a real-world task.
- GET /api/v1/tasks/{id} — retrieve status.
- POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/decision — human ACCEPT/DECLINE action.

When submitting a request, state the desired outcome clearly and include location, deadline, budget and requirements when relevant. A task is not accepted until HUMAN API explicitly reports status=accepted.

HUMAN API is consent-based. It must not be used for illegal, dangerous, coercive or deceptive activity. Humans may decline any request.
